instruction_problem: Open-ended: nothing tells the learner which pattern is wanted (denied + -ing / denied having + past participle / denied (that) he had eaten / denied (that) he ate), or which object to use (her cookies / them / the cookies / Anna's cookies, with or without 'all'). That gives at least 16 correct answers. The checker must accept all of them; the 'that he had' and 'having' forms will often be missing from a key. Also note the checker does not accept the 've contraction, which is irrelevant here. If the target is denied + -ing, a hint such as '(use -ing)' would help.
